capabilities: Toggle CSS snippets from a status bar popup
Create, edit, copy, and delete snippets from the popup
Add textured eye-care backgrounds (linen, dots, grid, stripe, aurora, breathe)
Pin a draggable floating button with dark/light gradient styles
extras: Pending review in the Obsidian community plugin directory; manual installation from GitHub releases is described. The author requests donations via a buy-me-a-coffee link. Manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Quickly toggle Obsidian CSS Snippets from a status bar popup.
problem: Obsidian's CSS snippet settings require opening the settings panel to enable or disable snippets, which is slow for frequent switching.
summary: CSS snippet manager that toggles snippets from a status bar popup, with groups, drag-and-drop, and new snippet creation.
